index-ventures._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company under different names across Index's surfaces (the live list, the archived listings 2008-2025, Form D issuer names) and its renames. Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed. Written at kickoff 2026-10-01 (PRO-82) before the first prepare.

merges.name: Captain Train
merges.reason: one company: Capitaine Train (the firm's 2014 page) renamed Captain Train in 2016, the year Trainline bought it; the firm's 2019-2025 pages carry it as Captain Train

merges.name: Edited
merges.reason: one company: EDITD (the firm's 2012-2014 listing) rebranded EDITED in 2015; the 2018-2023 pages carry the new spelling

merges.name: Elastic
merges.reason: one company: Elasticsearch (2013-2014 listing) renamed Elastic in 2015 (Elastic N.V., NYSE: ESTC; the Index funds' 13G filings)

merges.name: The Climate Corporation

merges.name: Fuze

merges.name: Notonthehighstreet

merges.name: NormOxys

never_merge.reason: two companies: Gather (gather.town, Gather Presence; the firm's page credits Danny Rimer) and Gather Wholesale Inc. (Walnut, CA; a 2020 Form D carrying Ilya Fushman as director two years after he left for Kleiner Perkins). The builder's prefix rule would fold the filing into the listed company.

two companies: Cue (CueCal, Inc., the calendar app the firm listed in 2020; Form D 2018, Dino Becirovic) and Cue Labs (Greplin renamed, the personal-assistant app Apple bought in 2013, in which the firm led an unannounced $10M round in November 2012)
